content.comment_body: Hello. I want to know which driver should be used to connect to [product_name]. I tried using the [product_name] communication protocol suite via TCP/IP and entered the IP of [product_name] (it's connected directly to the PC with a LAN cable), but it always shows as disconnected. Is there a special communication requirement I'm missing, or is there a downloadable driver for [product_name]? Best regards, [user_name]
Does the communication suite driver provide that protocol, or do I need to use OPC?
You should use the protocol suite. Access the memory of [product_name] by addressing DB1. Best regards, [user_name]
I can find the DB option in the protocol suite, but in [product_name] there's no place to select a DB. Which DB do I read from [product_name]?

I can only provide assistance regarding [product_name]. 1. [product_name] and S7-200 both use a short form of the S7 protocol which may not be integrated by default in [product_name] SCADA software. If it's not included, you'll need the OPC server from [company_name]. Address the [product_name] IP and use DB1 (since [product_name] only has DB1). To transfer data from [product_name] to memory, utilize the VM-mapping table available in the configuration software's tool section. Here you configure which function block parameters should be stored in V-Memory, allowing you to access them. To write to [product_name], target the corresponding VM address to update parameters (if write access is permitted). Hope this helps.

Use the protocol suite and set up an Ethernet connection. If prompted to choose a CPU, S7-300 should work. When configuring tags in [product_name] SCADA, for example, for VB0, use db1.dbb0. Best regards, [user_name]
Please send me an email. Thanks.
You can post your question here.
You can post your question here. I tried to communicate between [product_name] and [product_name] SCADA V7.4 but was unsuccessful. If possible, please send me a sample project. Thanks.
Currently, I don't have that backup. You can try using the settings from the provided screenshot; all the required settings are included.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing confusion and uncertainty when setting up communication between [product_name] and [product_name] SCADA software. Documentation on supported drivers and protocols appears to be unclear, resulting in attempts with various configurations and repeated requests for clarification from the community. Issues are noted in protocol compatibility and understanding of memory addressing and mapping between devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and straightforward documentation for protocol support between [product_name] and [product_name] SCADA software, with integrated driver options and guidance on memory addressing for direct device communication.
